updates.title: Stop-loss triggers move to mid price
updates.summary: Stops now trigger against the mid price rather than best bid or ask. A wider spread alone is less likely to trigger a stop.
updates.impact: Stop activation is based on the midpoint, not a directly executable bid/ask price. Slippage on the resulting exit can still occur.

updates.title: Funding framework revised
updates.summary: The in-app notice reports removal of the interest-rate component for index and futures-based perpetuals, a shorter index normalization window, and a unified clamp multiplier.
updates.impact: Funding is transferred between longs and shorts, not charged by Vest. The live docs list CME index futures at 0% annual base interest and a 48-hour normalization interval.
